Publication statement: A Paris : Se vend chez G. Danet, sur le pont N. Dame a la Sphere Royale, 1729.

Relief shown pictorially. Includes text, illustrations, including an armillary sphere and astronomical diagrams, table showing various units of measurement, and measurements of the size of the earth. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
